SUBUNIT: Interacts with ATP5F1B; involved in the assembly of the F1 component of the mitochondrial ATP synthase (ATPase). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:11410595}.
SUBUNIT: Dodecamer. Interacts with BFSP2 and VIM (By similarity). {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with RAB18 in a RAB3GAP1-dependent manner. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:37774976}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with UNG. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:18676834}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with MBD1, SETDB1 and SP1. Probably forms a complex with SETDB1 and MBD1.
SUBUNIT: Microtubule inner protein component of sperm flagellar doublet microtubules. Interacts with DLG3. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q6P8X9}.

SUBUNIT: Part of the multisubunit axonemal dynein complex formed at least of two heavy chains and a number of intermediate and light chains. Associated with axonemal dynein subunits such as, DNAH2, DNAI3, and DYNLT1. Interacts with DYNLT1. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:E9PYY5}.
SUBUNIT: Component of the nexin-dynein regulatory complex (N-DRC). {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:A8J3A0}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with SDHA in its FAD-bound form. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:P38345}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with IRAK1 and RELA. Interacts with HSPA8 and HSPA1 (By similarity). {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Forms homooligomers. Interacts with ADGRB3. Interacts with C1QL2 and C1QL4, when proteins are coexpressed; this interaction does not occur after secretion. {ECO:0000250}.

SUBUNIT: Component of a CRL2 E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase complex, also named ECS (Elongin BC-CUL2/5-SOCS-box protein) complex, composed of CUL2, Elongin BC (ELOB and ELOC), RBX1 and substrate-specific adapter PRAMEF6. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:26138980}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with ATP1B1. {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with TRPV5 and TRPV6. Interacts with YWHAZ/14-3-3 protein zeta (By similarity). {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Homodimer. {ECO:0000255|HAMAP-Rule:MF_03014}.

SUBUNIT: Component of the complex WDR11 composed of C17orf75, FAM91A1 and WDR11; FAM91A1 and WDR11 are required for proper location of the complex (PubMed:29426865). Interacts with golgins GOLGA1 and GOLGA4 and with TBC1D23; interaction with golgins may be mediated by TBC1D23 and interaction with TBC1D23 recruits TBC1D23 to AP-1-derived vesicles (PubMed:29084197, PubMed:29426865). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:29084197, ECO:0000269|PubMed:29426865}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with LRP6. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:21536646}.

SUBUNIT: PP2A consists of a common heterodimeric core enzyme, composed of a 36 kDa catalytic subunit (subunit C) and a 65 kDa constant regulatory subunit (PR65 or subunit A), that associates with a variety of regulatory subunits. Proteins that associate with the core dimer include three families of regulatory subunits B (the R2/B/PR55/B55, R3/B''/PR72/PR130/PR59 and R5/B'/B56 families), the 48 kDa variable regulatory subunit, viral proteins, and cell signaling molecules. Interacts with ENSA (when phosphorylated at 'Ser-67') and ARPP19 (when phosphorylated at 'Ser-62'), leading to inhibit PP2A activity (By similarity). Interacts with IER5 (PubMed:25816751). {ECO:0000250, ECO:0000269|PubMed:25816751}.
SUBUNIT: Homodimer. Binds to heparin and chondroitin sulfate E. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q8BHP7}.

SUBUNIT: Homopentamer; forms an open pentamer (PubMed:28963344). In contrast to other BTB domain-containing proteins, does not interact with CUL3 (PubMed:28963344). Interacts as a tetramer with GABRB1 and GABRB2. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q5DTY9, ECO:0000269|PubMed:28963344}.

SUBUNIT: Homopentamer. Interacts with KCTD6 and KCTD21; KCTD11 and KCTD6 or KCTD21 may associate in pentameric assemblies. Component of the BCR(KCTD11) E3 ubiquitin ligase complex, at least composed of CUL3 and KCTD11 and RBX1. Interacts (via BTB domain) with CUL3; initially a 4:4 stoichiometry has been reported, however, electron microscopy revealed pentameric states of the BTB domain. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:21237243, ECO:0000269|PubMed:21472142, ECO:0000269|PubMed:25974686, ECO:0000269|PubMed:27152988}.

SUBUNIT: Interacts with UQCRC1 (PubMed:32161263). Interacts with UQCRQ (By similarity). Interacts with UQCC5 (PubMed:34969438). Forms a complex, named COMB/coordinator of mitochondrial CYTB biogenesis, composed of UQCC1, UQCC2, UQCC4, UQCC5 and UQCC6; stabilizes nascent cytochrome b/MT-CYB and promotes its membrane insertion. Forms a complex, named COMA, composed of UQCC1, UQCC2 and UQCC4; activates MT-CYB translation. Forms a complex, named COMC, composed of UQCC1, UQCC2; UQCC3 and UQCC4; mediates MT-CYB hemylation and association with the first nuclear-encoded complex III subunit UQCRQ (By similarity). Interacts with MT-CYB (By similarity). {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q8BTC1}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with PRDM16; preventing the interaction between PRDM16 and PPARG. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q99J47}.

SUBUNIT: homotetramer (Probable). Interacts with NDUFAB1 (PubMed:27499296). Interacts with ETFA (PubMed:27499296). Interacts with ETFB (PubMed:27499296). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:27499296, ECO:0000305|PubMed:27499296}.
SUBUNIT: May interact with SMARCA4/BRG1. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q8CHC8}.
SUBUNIT: Microtubule inner protein component of sperm flagellar doublet microtubules. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q9D4K5}.
SUBUNIT: Self-associates (Probable). Interacts with CUL3; indicative for the participation in an E3 ubiquitin ligase complex (By similarity). {ECO:0000250, ECO:0000305}.

SUBUNIT: Interacts with 'R7' family proteins RGS6, RGS7, RGS9 and RGS11. Component of some R7-Gbeta5 complex composed of some R7 protein (RGS6, RGS7, RGS9 or RGS11), Gbeta5 (GNB5) and RGS7BP. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q8BQP9}.
SUBUNIT: Constitutively interacts with CASP4; required for the localization of procaspase 4 to the ER.

SUBUNIT: Component of the TTT complex composed of TELO2, TTI1 and TTI2. Interacts with TELO2 and TTI1 (PubMed:20801936, PubMed:20810650). Interacts with WAC; WAC positively regulates MTOR activity by promoting the assembly of the TTT complex and the RUVBL complex composed of RUVBL1 and RUVBL2 into the TTT-RUVBL complex which leads to the dimerization of the mTORC1 complex and its subsequent activation (PubMed:26812014). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:20801936, ECO:0000269|PubMed:20810650, ECO:0000269|PubMed:26812014}.

SUBUNIT: Component of the mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit (mt-LSU) (PubMed:25278503, PubMed:25838379, PubMed:28892042, PubMed:35177605). Mature mammalian 55S mitochondrial ribosomes consist of a small (28S) and a large (39S) subunit. The 28S small subunit contains a 12S ribosomal RNA (12S mt-rRNA) and 30 different proteins. The 39S large subunit contains a 16S rRNA (16S mt-rRNA), a copy of mitochondrial valine transfer RNA (mt-tRNA(Val)), which plays an integral structural role, and 52 different proteins (PubMed:25278503, PubMed:25838379). Interacts with MALSU1 (PubMed:22829778). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:22829778, ECO:0000269|PubMed:25278503, ECO:0000269|PubMed:25838379, ECO:0000269|PubMed:28892042, ECO:0000269|PubMed:35177605}.
SUBUNIT: Monomer. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q9BEA2}.

SUBUNIT: Associates with the gamma-tubulin ring complex (gTuRC) consisting of TUBGCP2, TUBGCP3, TUBGCP4, TUBGCP5 and TUBGCP6 and gamma-tubulin TUBG1 or TUBG2; within the complex, interacts with TUBGCP2; the interaction plays a role in gTuRC activation. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:20360068, ECO:0000269|PubMed:39321809}.
SUBUNIT: Microtubule inner protein component of sperm flagellar doublet microtubules. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q6P8Y0}.
SUBUNIT: Forms a complex with IZUMO1 and SPACA6 on spermatocyte cell membrane required for fertilization. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:39423812}.
SUBUNIT: A connexon is composed of a hexamer of connexins. {ECO:0000250}.

SUBUNIT: Interacts with DNTTIP1 (PubMed:21573134, PubMed:25653165). Identified in a histone deacetylase complex that contains DNTTIP1, HDAC1 and MIDEAS; this complex assembles into a tetramer that contains four copies of each protein chain (PubMed:25653165). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:21573134, ECO:0000269|PubMed:25653165}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts via the beta domain with the ODD domain of HIF1A. This interaction is independent of prolyl hydroxylation of HIF1A. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:14757845}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with TAF3. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q6SJ95}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with UBF/UBTF. {ECO:0000250}.

SUBUNIT: Interacts with F-actin; the interaction disrupts the F-actin structures and leads to marked changes of neuronal morphology. Component of a complex, composed of PDZK1, SYNGAP1, KLHL17 and NMDA receptors. Interacts directly with PDZK1 (via PDZ1 domain); the interaction is important for integrity of actin cytoskeleton structures in neurons. Interacts with DLG4 and SYNGAP1. Interacts (via kelch repeats) with GRIK2 (via C-terminus); the interaction targets GRIK2 for degradation via ubiquitin-proteasome pathway. Interacts with GRIK1. Interacts with (via BTB domain) CUL3; the interaction regulates surface GRIK2 expression (By similarity). {ECO:0000250}.

SUBUNIT: Heterohexamer; disulfide-linked heterotrimers. Interacts with CBLN1. May also form oligomers with CBLN2 and CBLN4 (By similarity). {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q9JHG0, ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q9R171}.
SUBUNIT: Homodimer; disulfide-linked. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:21454693}.

SUBUNIT: Part of a oolemmal binding multimeric complex (IZUMO1 complex) composed at least of IZUMO1 and GLIPR1L1; the complex assemblage is influenced by the maturation status of the male germ cell. Interacts with IZUMO1. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q9DAG6}.
SUBUNIT: May form dimers. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q8K1F9}.

SUBUNIT: Found in a complex with PET110, PET117 and isoform 2/MR-1S of PNKD (PubMed:28199844). Interacts with TACO1; regulates the stability of TACO1 and prevent its ubiquitination thereby plays a role in regulating the expression of COX1 (PubMed:37247699). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:28199844, ECO:0000269|PubMed:37247699}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with WWOX. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:22226915}.
SUBUNIT: Homodimer. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:20578903}.
SUBUNIT: Binds to numerous extracellular matrix proteins. {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Binds dermatan sulfate and chondroitin sulfate. {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with PDE3B; this interaction regulates PDE3B's stability and expression and, thereby, impacts the antilipolytic action of insulin. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q5F2F2}.

SUBUNIT: Component of the inner core of AMPAR complex. AMPAR complex consists of an inner core made of 4 pore-forming GluA/GRIA proteins (GRIA1, GRIA2, GRIA3 and GRIA4) and 4 major auxiliary subunits arranged in a twofold symmetry. One of the two pairs of distinct binding sites is occupied either by CNIH2, CNIH3 or CACNG2, CACNG3. The other harbors CACNG2, CACNG3, CACNG4, CACNG8 or GSG1L. This inner core of AMPAR complex is complemented by outer core constituents binding directly to the GluA/GRIA proteins at sites distinct from the interaction sites of the inner core constituents. Outer core constituents include at least PRRT1, PRRT2, CKAMP44/SHISA9, FRRS1L and NRN1. The proteins of the inner and outer core serve as a platform for other, more peripherally associated AMPAR constituents. Alone or in combination, these auxiliary subunits control the gating and pharmacology of the AMPAR complex and profoundly impact their biogenesis and protein processing (By similarity). {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with HUS1, HUS1B, RAD1, RAD9A and RAD17. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:14500360, ECO:0000269|PubMed:14611806}.

SUBUNIT: Component of the cytochrome c oxidase (complex IV, CIV), a multisubunit enzyme composed of 14 subunits. The complex is composed of a catalytic core of 3 subunits MT-CO1, MT-CO2 and MT-CO3, encoded in the mitochondrial DNA, and 11 supernumerary subunits COX4I1 (or COX4I2), COX5A, COX5B, COX6A1 (or COX6A2), COX6B1 (or COX6B2), COX6C, COX7A2 (or COX7A1), COX7B, COX7C, COX8A and COXFA4, which are encoded in the nuclear genome (By similarity). The complex exists as a monomer or a dimer and forms supercomplexes (SCs) in the inner mitochondrial membrane with NADH-ubiquinone oxidoreductase (complex I, CI) and ubiquinol-cytochrome c oxidoreductase (cytochrome b-c1 complex, complex III, CIII), resulting in different assemblies (supercomplex SCI(1)III(2)IV(1) and megacomplex MCI(2)III(2)IV(2)) (By similarity). {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:P00429}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with ATP2A2. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q3U145}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts (via C-terminus) with PLEKHM1; this interaction is weak but increased in a RAB7A-dependent manner. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q99J78}.

SUBUNIT: Part of a tripartite complex with dynein and dynactin, acts an adapter linking the dynein motor complex and dynactin. Interacts with KIF1C. Interacts with RAB6A and RAB6B; interaction is specific to Rab6. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:A0JNT9}.

SUBUNIT: Component of the CatSper complex or CatSpermasome composed of the core pore-forming members CATSPER1, CATSPER2, CATSPER3 and CATSPER4 as well as auxiliary members CATSPERB, CATSPERG, CATSPERD, CATSPERE, CATSPERZ, CATSPERT, CATSPERQ, CATSPERH and EFCAB9. HSPA1 may be an additional auxiliary complex member. The core complex members CATSPER1, CATSPER2, CATSPER3 and CATSPER4 form a heterotetrameric channel. The auxiliary CATSPERB, CATSPERG, CATSPERD and CATSPERE subunits form a pavilion-like structure over the pore which stabilizes the complex through interactions with CATSPER4, CATSPER3, CATSPER1 and CATSPER2 respectively. CATSPERH interacts with CATSPERB, further stabilizing the complex. CATSPERT interacts at least with CATSPERD and is required for targeting the CatSper complex in the flagellar membrane. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:C6KI89}.
SUBUNIT: May interact (via the Rho-GAP domain) with the active form of RAC1. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:35986704}.
SUBUNIT: Homodimerizes (PubMed:31311869). Interacts with CRK isoform CRK-II; the interaction requires PEAK3 homodimerization (PubMed:31311869). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:31311869}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with HSP90AB1. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:E9Q2M9}.
SUBUNIT: Specifically interacts with retina-specific isoform RGS9-1. Component of the RGS9-1-GNB5 (isoform Gbeta5L)-RGS9P complex. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q148R9}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with GPHN. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q3USH1}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts (via homeobox domain) with APBB1 (via PID domain 1). {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with FLNA and FLNB. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q7TS73}.
SUBUNIT: Homodimer (via BAR-like domain) (PubMed:27528616). Heterodimer (via BAR-like domain) with FAM92A (PubMed:27528616). Interacts with CBY1 (PubMed:27528616). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:27528616}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with MYO3A (via C-terminus). Interacts with MYO3B (via C-terminus). {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q3UYR4}.
SUBUNIT: Homodimer. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:23161870}.

SUBUNIT: Interacts with BMP7 and, by doing so, enhances binding to the type I receptors that contains cytoplasmic serine/threonine protein kinase domains. Also able to interact with activin-A and TGFB1 (By similarity). {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with hair keratins.
SUBUNIT: Interacts (when myristoylated) with UNC119 and UNC119B; interaction is required for localization to cilium. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:22085962}.
SUBUNIT: Binds to various extracellular matrix proteins. {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with NRXN1. {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with phosphorylated 'Tyr-720' of PDGFRA via its SH2 domain. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:11095946}.

SUBUNIT: Forms homodimers or heterodimers with TCF3 gene products E12 and E47. These dimers bind to the E-box site, however, heterodimer with MYOD1 does not bind target DNA (By similarity). {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with transcription factor TCF3/E12. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:M0QWB7}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with activated forms of GNAI1, GNAO1 and GNAZ. {ECO:0000250}.

SUBUNIT: Component of the mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit (mt-LSU) (PubMed:25278503, PubMed:25838379, PubMed:28892042, PubMed:35177605). Mature mammalian 55S mitochondrial ribosomes consist of a small (28S) and a large (39S) subunit. The 28S small subunit contains a 12S ribosomal RNA (12S mt-rRNA) and 30 different proteins. The 39S large subunit contains a 16S rRNA (16S mt-rRNA), a copy of mitochondrial valine transfer RNA (mt-tRNA(Val)), which plays an integral structural role, and 52 different proteins. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:25278503, ECO:0000269|PubMed:25838379, ECO:0000269|PubMed:28892042, ECO:0000269|PubMed:35177605}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with PIEZO2; the interaction inhibits PIEZO2-conducted mechanically activated currents. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q8C428}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with PIK3CD. {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Homodimer. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:P53144}.

SUBUNIT: Part of the MCD recombinosome complex, at least composed of IHO1, REC114 and MEI4 (By similarity). Forms a complex with MEI4; the interaction is required for MEI4 stability (PubMed:31704776). Interacts (via C-terminal domain) with MEI4 (via N-terminal domain) (PubMed:38148155). Interacts with IHO1 (PubMed:31704776). Interacts with ANKRD31; the interaction is direct (By similarity). Interacts with TOP6BL; promoting the activity of the SPO11-TOP6BL heterotetramer and formation of meiotic DNA double-strand breaks (By similarity). {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q9CWH4, ECO:0000269|PubMed:31704776, ECO:0000269|PubMed:38148155}.
SUBUNIT: Homodimer; disulfide-linked. {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Part of the GGTase-3 complex, composed of PTAR1 and RABGGTB; this complex geranylgeranylates FBXL2 and YKT6. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:31209342, ECO:0000269|PubMed:32128853}.
SUBUNIT: Found in a complex at least composed of MROH2B, PRKACA isoform 2 and TCP11. Interacts with PRKACA. Interacts with TCP11. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q7M6Y6}.

SUBUNIT: Component of the mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit (mt-LSU) (PubMed:25838379, PubMed:28892042). Mature mammalian 55S mitochondrial ribosomes consist of a small (28S) and a large (39S) subunit. The 28S small subunit contains a 12S ribosomal RNA (12S mt-rRNA) and 30 different proteins. The 39S large subunit contains a 16S rRNA (16S mt-rRNA), a copy of mitochondrial valine transfer RNA (mt-tRNA(Val)), which plays an integral structural role, and 52 different proteins. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:25838379, ECO:0000269|PubMed:28892042, ECO:0000305|PubMed:25838379}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with DPPA4. {ECO:0000250}.

SUBUNIT: Interacts with GABA(A) receptor subunits (PubMed:28978485). Identified in a complex of 720 kDa composed of LHFPL4, NLGN2, GABRA1, GABRB2, GABRG2 and GABRB3 (By similarity). Interacts with GABRB3 (By similarity). Interacts with GABRA2 (By similarity). Interacts with GABRG2 (By similarity). Interacts with GABRA1 (PubMed:28978485). Interacts with NLGN2; leading to mutual regulation of protein level and synaptic clustering (By similarity). {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q5U4E0, ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q7TSY2, ECO:0000269|PubMed:28978485}.

SUBUNIT: Component of the MITRAC (mitochondrial translation regulation assembly intermediate of cytochrome c oxidase complex) complex, the core components of this complex being COA3/MITRAC12 and COX14. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:23260140}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with YBX2. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q80SU3}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with EXOC2, EXOC4 and EXOC5; may be part of the exocyst. {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with DYSF and PPP1CA. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:19389623, ECO:0000269|Ref.1}.
SUBUNIT: Binds AMIGO1 or AMIGO2. {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with MSH5. Interacts with TEX11. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:A0A087WRU1}.

SUBUNIT: Component of the heterodimeric RalGAP1 complex with RALGAPA1 and of the heterodimeric RalGAP2 complex with RALGAPA2. Heterodimerization is required for activity (By similarity). {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Part of the tectonic-like complex (also named B9 complex). {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with the SH3 domains of GRB2 and PLCG1. Interacts with RALA. {ECO:0000250}.

SUBUNIT: Interacts with glycogen, PPP1CC catalytic subunit of PP1 and PYGL. Associates with glycogen particles. Forms complexes with debranching enzyme, glycogen phosphorylase, glycogen synthase and phosphorylase kinase which is necessary for its regulation of PP1 activity (By similarity). {ECO:0000250}.

SUBUNIT: Interacts with TET2 and OGT; this interaction mediates TET2 O-GlcNAcylation and stability by promoting the interaction between OGT and TET2 (PubMed:34667079). Interacts with KDM6A (PubMed:34667079). Interacts with TET1 (PubMed:34667079). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:34667079}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with TFF2 (By similarity). Heterodimer with TFF1; disulfide linked. {ECO:0000250, ECO:0000269|PubMed:15924415}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with ACHE, probably through disulfide bonds. {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with IGFBP3. Interacts with CASP8. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:20353938}.
SUBUNIT: Monomer and homodimer.
SUBUNIT: Homotrimer. {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with PRM2. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q8C5P7}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with hair keratins.

SUBUNIT: Component of the multisubunit TRAPP (transport protein particle) complex, which includes at least TRAPPC2, TRAPPC2L, TRAPPC3, TRAPPC3L, TRAPPC4, TRAPPC5, TRAPPC8, TRAPPC9, TRAPPC10, TRAPPC11 and TRAPPC12. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:21525244}.
SUBUNIT: Homodimer (By similarity). Can also form heterodimers (By similarity). Interacts with SYT1 (By similarity). {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:P97610, ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q9R0N7}.

SUBUNIT: Part of a SCF (SKP1-cullin-F-box) protein ligase complex. Interacts with CTNNB1 (PubMed:30714168). Interacts with HNRNPL (PubMed:34333526). Interacts with RELA (PubMed:40529355). Interacts with ULK1 (PubMed:39384743). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:30714168, ECO:0000269|PubMed:34333526, ECO:0000269|PubMed:39384743, ECO:0000269|PubMed:40529355}.
SUBUNIT: Component of a phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase (PI4K) complex, composed of PI4KA, EFR3 (EFR3A or EFR3B), TTC7 (TTC7A or TTC7B) and HYCC (HYCC1 or HYCC2). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:26571211}.

SUBUNIT: Interacts with KEAP1; this interaction prevents the ubiquitination of KEAP1 by TRIM25, thus protecting KEAP1 from degradation (PubMed:36882524). Found in association with PDCD10 and members of the STE20 kinases, such as STK24, STK25 and STK26 (PubMed:38517886). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:36882524, ECO:0000269|PubMed:38517886}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with PTBP1, RAVER2, VCL and ACTN1. Part of a complex containing RAVER1, VCL and ACTN1 (By similarity). {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts (via N-terminus) with RAB2B (in GTP-bound form). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:26209634}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with SPG21. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:19184135}.

SUBUNIT: Part of the ciliary outer dynein arms (ODAs), at least consisting of dynein axonemal heavy chains, light chains and intermediate chains (By similarity). The ODAs interacts with DNAAF9; this interaction inactivates the dyneins (By similarity). Interacts with CCDC159 (By similarity). Interacts with CSNK2B (By similarity). {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:C0HME8, ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:P11985}.

SUBUNIT: Dimer formed of alpha-2-2 and delta-2 chains; disulfide-linked. Voltage-dependent calcium channels are multisubunit complexes, consisting of alpha-1 (CACNA1), alpha-2 (CACNA2D), beta (CACNB) and delta (CACNA2D) subunits in a 1:1:1:1 ratio (By similarity). {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Associates with the pre-60S ribosomal particles. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:26711351}.
SUBUNIT: Homodimer (PubMed:11311134). Interacts with AHI1 (By similarity). {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:Q9JKC6, ECO:0000269|PubMed:11311134}.
SUBUNIT: Can bind to ADAM11, ADAM22 and ADAM23. {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Associates with BCL6 through the BTB domain. {ECO:0000250}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with GRB2. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:18559951}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with COX5B; this interaction may contribute to localize PYROXD2 to the inner face of the inner mitochondrial membrane. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:31170524}.
SUBUNIT: Interacts with PER2, CRY2, BHLHE41, HDAC1 and NR3C1 (By similarity). Interacts with BMAL1. {ECO:0000250, ECO:0000269|PubMed:24385426}.

SUBUNIT: Interacts with HSP70. Associates with HSP90. Interacts with TSSK6; this interaction is direct and recruits TSACC to HSP90. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:20829357}.

The proton translocation complex V0 consists of the proton transport subunit a, a ring of proteolipid subunits c9c'', rotary subunit d, subunits e and f, and the accessory subunits ATP6AP1/Ac45 and ATP6AP2/PRR. {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:P36543}.

The gamma-delta TR is associated with the transmembrane signaling CD3 coreceptor proteins following the stoichiometry: a single gamma-delta TR heterodimer associates with one CD3D-CD3E heterodimer, one CD3G-CD3E heterodimer and one CD247 homodimer forming a stable octameric structure. SUBUNIT: Most probably, the alpha-beta TR is not assembled due to incorrect folding of the beta chain (Probable). Alpha-beta TR is a heterodimer composed of an alpha and beta chain; disulfide-linked. The alpha-beta TR is associated with the transmembrane signaling CD3 coreceptor proteins to form the TR-CD3 (TcR or TCR). The assembly of alpha-beta TR heterodimers with CD3 occurs in the endoplasmic reticulum where a single alpha-beta TR heterodimer associates with one CD3D-CD3E heterodimer, one CD3G-CD3E heterodimer and one CD247 homodimer forming a stable octameric structure. CD3D-CD3E and CD3G-CD3E heterodimers preferentially associate with TR alpha and TR beta chains, respectively. The association of the CD247 homodimer is the last step of TcR assembly in the endoplasmic reticulum and is required for transport to the cell surface. {ECO:0000303|PubMed:20452950, ECO:0000305}.

The assembly of alpha-beta TR heterodimers with CD3 occurs in the endoplasmic reticulum where a single alpha-beta TR heterodimer associates with one CD3D-CD3E heterodimer, one CD3G-CD3E heterodimer and one CD247 homodimer forming a stable octameric structure. CD3D-CD3E and CD3G-CD3E heterodimers preferentially associate with TR alpha and TR beta chains, respectively. The association of the CD247 homodimer is the last step of TcR assembly in the endoplasmic reticulum and is required for transport to the cell surface. {ECO:0000303|PubMed:20452950}.

SUBUNIT: Alpha-beta TR is a heterodimer composed of an alpha and beta chain; disulfide-linked. The alpha-beta TR is associated with the transmembrane signaling CD3 coreceptor proteins to form the TR-CD3 (TcR or TCR). The assembly of alpha-beta TR heterodimers with CD3 occurs in the endoplasmic reticulum where a single alpha-beta TR heterodimer associates with one CD3D-CD3E heterodimer, one CD3G-CD3E heterodimer and one CD247 homodimer forming a stable octameric structure. CD3D-CD3E and CD3G-CD3E heterodimers preferentially associate with TR alpha and TR beta chains, respectively. SUBUNIT: Alpha-beta TR is a heterodimer composed of an alpha and beta chain; disulfide-linked. The alpha-beta TR is associated with the transmembrane signaling CD3 coreceptor proteins to form the TR-CD3 (TcR or TCR). The assembly of alpha-beta TR heterodimers with CD3 occurs in the endoplasmic reticulum where a single alpha-beta TR heterodimer associates with one CD3D-CD3E heterodimer, one CD3G-CD3E heterodimer and one CD247 homodimer forming a stable octameric structure. CD3D-CD3E and CD3G-CD3E heterodimers preferentially associate with TR alpha and TR beta chains, respectively. The association of the CD247 homodimer is the last step of TcR assembly in the endoplasmic reticulum and is required for transport to the cell surface. {ECO:0000303|PubMed:20452950}.
